label: coach of
definition: Person X coaches or coached sports team or collegiate athletic program Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit coach title; direct coaching with correct subject and team; former/dismissed coach with clear office evidence; team/university shorthand when the athletic program role is clear. Excludes: manager/president/player alone; winning with a team alone; vacancy consideration alone; reverse team-to-coach direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: missing coach subject or team attachment.
